D: A boy raised by wolves travels through the jungle with a panther and a bear to reach the man village.
P: Serve the snacks when Baloo floats down the river with Mowgli on his belly.
S: Baloo shaking fruit down from the trees
Banana slices dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed peanuts and coconut, frozen on a tray for 30 minutes.
Mango, pineapple, papaya and lychee piled on banana leaves with lime and a sprinkle of chilli salt.
Kaa's spinach and feta pastry coils
Kaa the snake coiling around Mowgli

Spinach, feta and dill wrapped in flaky pastry and coiled up like Kaa, baked golden, with a cooling mint yoghurt and a hit of chilli. Wilt 300g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g crumbled feta, 1 egg, chopped dill and pepper. Cut 2 puff pastry sheets into 4 long strips each, spoon filling along each strip and roll over to enclose. Coil each strip into a snail shape on a lined tray, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Mix 200g yoghurt with chopped mint and a pinch of chilli flakes to serve.
M: Chicken thighs simmered in a tomato and coconut curry with garlic, ginger, garam masala and curry leaves, served with basmati rice and naan.
Man village tadka dal with roti
the man village at the end of the journey

Red lentils simmered silky with turmeric, garlic and ginger, finished with sizzling cumin, chilli and ghee, with rice, warm roti and lime pickle. Rinse 300g red lentils and simmer in 1.2L water with 1 tsp turmeric, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 25 minutes until soft, then season. Cook 300g basmati rice. Heat 40g ghee, add 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 dried chilli and 1 sliced onion and fry until golden, then pour over the dal sizzling. Warm 8 roti and serve with lime pickle and coriander.
W: Coconut milk and sugar set with gelatine in glasses, topped with mango and toasted coconut.
K: Ripe mango blended with yoghurt, milk, a little sugar and cardamom, poured over ice.

s.note: Baloo shaking fruit down from the trees
s.how: Slice 3 bananas into thick rounds. Dip each halfway into 150g melted dark chocolate, then roll in crushed peanuts mixed with coconut. Lay on a lined tray and freeze for 30 minutes. Serve straight from the freezer on a hot afternoon.

Lay banana leaves on a platter. Pile on wedges of mango, pineapple and papaya with a drained can of lychees. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with salt mixed with a pinch of chilli. Fit for a king of the ancient ruins.

m.how: Soften grated ginger and garlic in oil, add 2 tsp garam masala and fry a minute. Add 1kg chicken thighs, a can of crushed tomatoes and 400ml coconut milk and simmer 30 minutes. Serve with basmati rice and warm naan.

w.how: Warm 800ml coconut milk with 100g sugar until dissolved. Soak 4 gelatine sheets, squeeze and stir in. Pour into glasses and chill for 4 hours. Top with diced mango and toasted shredded coconut.

d.how: Blend the flesh of 2 ripe mangoes with 300g Greek yoghurt, 250ml cold milk, a spoon of sugar and a pinch of cardamom until smooth. Pour over ice in tall glasses. Cool enough for the hottest day in the jungle.
